scope: Original graphical assets and verified structural exports; English reference evidence

claims.finding: a_texCoord.xy supplies UV, z supplies lighting, w supplies drawToEdge; a_position.w is forwarded separately as a multiplier. Vertex xyz is projected through CC_MVPMatrix.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: newY=(1-edge)*y+edge*min(y+u_params.y,u_cameraBottom); diff=newY-y; texScale=diff/u_params.y. x offset=u_params.x*edge, z offset=u_params.z*max(1,texScale)*edge; UV.y receives u_params.w*texScale. This is shader-side bottom extension/tiling, not a terrain generator.
claims.limitation: No CPU mesh creation, triangulation, physics collision, coordinate units, camera follow law or protection against zero u_params.y is proven here.

claims.finding: Active fragment expression is texture2D(CC_Texture0,UV)*vec4(light,light,light,1)*multiplier. Declared u_texture is unused in the active expression.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Tunnel shader treats input position.w as lighting and projects xyz using CC_MVPMatrix.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Tunnel texture RGB is multiplied by interpolated lighting; alpha is not multiplied by lighting in this expression.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Caustic blend coefficient is clamp((vertexY-u_depthfade.y)/u_depthfade.x,0,1). Depth here is a height-driven factor, not a sampled depth buffer.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Caustics mix CC_Texture2 and CC_Texture0 by the vertex coefficient; multiply lighting and multiplier; then add shifted CC_Texture1 RGB weighted by alpha, coefficient and 9.5*y*(1-y)^3.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Parallax vertex projection uses CC_PMatrix and divides incoming UV.y by multi_size.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Nine entries supplied by loop1/2/3 select vertical texture strip offsets using a wrapped floor-based index. Horizontal coordinate scales by aspectX/multi_scale.
claims.limitation: No CPU parallax layer velocities, camera displacement coupling or layer scheduling can be inferred from these uniforms.

claims.finding: After CC_MVPMatrix projection, clip-space y receives u_b*sin(u_a*CC_Time[0]); UV.y is flipped. This differs from moving a world-space rigid body.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Uses u_ssize_cview and CC_PMatrix to convert supplied player position to screen-related coordinates, passing it to the fragment stage; geometry also uses CC_PMatrix.
claims.limitation: Uniform producer and camera model remain unknown. An author comment expresses uncertainty; it is not a reliable specification.

claims.finding: Samples a field from CC_Texture0, computes d=(0.5/16)/field.a; for d<1 samples CC_Texture1 at 0.5+d*normalize(field.rg-0.5), otherwise discards.
claims.limitation: Shows a two-texture liquid-field composition capability. Does not establish the field accumulation pass, blend state, render-target resolution or simulation.

claims.finding: For u_intensity>0.01, creates aspect-correct rotated tiled procedural droplet masks, distorts scene UV toward a centered 1.075 scale, and mixes a water tint. Otherwise copies CC_Texture0.
claims.limitation: Declared uniforms and commented experiments are not active behavior. Weather triggers, intensity curves, framebuffer setup and pass ordering are not established.

claims.finding: Despite multiple declared uniforms, active main only samples CC_Texture0 and writes the result.
claims.limitation: Names and declarations alone must not be described as a functioning multi-input postprocessor.

claims.finding: Active fragment main is a direct texture copy; debug overloads above are unused here.
claims.limitation: Filename does not prove animated sprites. Vertex time varying is not read by active fragment code.

claims.finding: Sky fragment is texture2D(u_texture,UV)*u_color.
claims.limitation: Shipped shader source establishes this computation; active program selection, uniform values, render state and CPU callers are not established by this source alone.

claims.finding: Original OBJ header identifies Blender 2.91.2 and arena-ramp12.blend; this file contains 77 position vertices,126 UV records,91 face records,0 vn records and one material use. Coordinates include differing z values, demonstrating authored 3D mesh geometry.
claims.limitation: One static ramp mesh is not evidence of terrain topology construction, runtime collision mesh, perspective camera, or a fully 3D game simulation.

claims.finding: Material provides Ns/Ka/Kd/Ks/Ke/Ni/d/illum and map_Kd arena-ramp.png.
claims.limitation: These are supplied material records; importer support and exact GPU interpretation need runtime/native evidence.

claims.finding: TexturePacker format3 metadata names savanna_gfx.png,512x1024,RGBA8888,premultiplyAlpha=false. Tree frame records textureRect {{1,1},{466,512}}, spriteSourceSize512x512, offset{-3,0}, textureRotated=false.
claims.limitation: Frame metadata permits faithful atlas placement; it does not independently establish runtime blending or parallax motion.

claims.finding: Atlas names nationalpark_adventure_icon.png,1254x1032,Linear/Linear filters, packed bounds and optional offsets/90-degree rotations.
claims.limitation: Atlas regions alone do not define skeleton animation playback or UI selection behavior.

claims.finding: Authored action duration1393,speed0.5;25 named clips include rank1 frames0–18,rank6 frames385–401,rank6_idle frames1325–1393. Timeline entries bind by actionTag and carry frameIndex,tween,easingData.
claims.limitation: Frame indices are stored indices, not seconds. Clip trigger conditions and actual playback rate/framebase require runtime evidence.

claims.finding: Verified base inventory records128.vsh,126.fsh,276.obj,209.mtl,1255.csb,549.plist,447.ogg,7115.png,191.rube and1794.json assets.
claims.limitation: Counts concern shipped base asset files, not runtime-loaded resources or semantic recovery. Resource-split media and derived outputs are separate.

claims.finding: 191 RUBE plus1717 JSON-extension files have shared binary prefix1213aa1213ba13ba and no validated format reader.
claims.limitation: Extensions are not decoded schemas. Terrain/vehicle numerical definitions cannot be quoted from these; binary prefix alone does not establish encryption.

claims.locator: complete original DAT and inflated payload roots
claims.finding: DAT work preserves63 complete supported wire streams,42 unsupported original streams and36 complete zlib payloads, retaining wire numbers,raw byte ranges and unproven nested candidates.
claims.limitation: Physical wire compatibility is not a validated replay/physics schema. Historical hcr2_replay.proto semantics must not be promoted to facts.

claims.finding: Transforms mask UV through u_transform, subtracts atlas center, compensates aspect and divides by supplied sheet column/row counts. Source comment identifies SpriteTransforms::setMaskUniforms() as the intended transform producer.
claims.limitation: The comment is a useful native-search lead, not a verified call binding. Actual transforms and sheet dimensions require the producer.

claims.finding: Samples tier0 then traverses sheet stages; u_blendmode0 interpolates RGB between successive tiers based on u_blend, other modes select completed tiers. Alpha is retained from tier0; final color is multiplied by parent tint/opacity and vertex color.
claims.limitation: The visual blend does not establish tire damage, grip, upgrade or wear semantics. CPU meaning and value range of u_blend are unverified.

claims.finding: Rotational blur uses10 samples, repeatedly rotating the sampling offset by u_params.z; valid atlas samples contribute squared RGBA and output is sqrt(sum/10). An annular spinner region instead takes one stationary sample. Translational blur matrix code is commented out.
claims.limitation: This is atlas-local rotational texture blur, not proof of full-screen velocity-buffer motion blur. Angular uniform source and physical wheel-speed coupling remain unverified.

claims.finding: Vehicle iridescence samples separate mask and base textures, derives a brightness-weighted red-channel mask, rotates normalized fragment coordinates by0.25*u_playerRot+time, synthesizes HSV color and overlays it with a0.2*mask mix.
claims.limitation: u_playerRot proves an input dependency in this shader, not a verified CPU vehicle orientation producer or shader-selection rule.

claims.finding: Box blur samples a square UV neighborhood using step-controlled nested loops and multiplies the sum by step squared; u_box_blur packs boxSize,step,pixel dimensions.
claims.limitation: Sampling behavior follows the exact loop bounds; do not substitute a mathematically normalized kernel without checking the supplied step. Actual render target and pass scheduling unknown.
